data.current_summary: Remote Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless)
data.current_description: MCP JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP, not a REST route. Send JSON-RPC messages with Content-Type: application/json and Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. Responses stream as Server-Sent Events (including notifications/progress during long naming sprints) or plain JSON. Stateless: no Mcp-Session-Id is issued and GET/DELETE return 405. Requires a NamingSignal user API key as the Authorization Bearer token; every tool call is authenticated, metered, and rate-limited by the /api/v1 routes it invokes with that key. Tools: compile_project_brief, create_naming_sprint, check_names, analyze_candidates, get_purchase_links.
data.summary_suggestion: Execute naming operations via Model Context Protocol
data.description_suggestion: Provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) interface for naming operations over Streamable HTTP using JSON-RPC 2.0. This stateless endpoint accepts JSON-RPC requests with Content-Type: application/json and returns responses as Server-Sent Events (SSE) for streaming progress during long-running operations, or plain JSON for immediate responses. Authentication is required via Bearer token (NamingSignal API key); all tool invocations are metered and rate-limited. Available tools: compile_project_brief, create_naming_sprint, check_names, analyze_candidates, get_purchase_links. Note: This is not a REST endpoint; GET and DELETE requests return 405 Method Not Allowed. No session management (Mcp-Session-Id) is maintained.
